bear.t: Regulatory, Operational & Legal Risk from NetNut Disruption
bear.b: Domain seizures, service pauses and ongoing probes create structural operational and compliance risk for the proxy business. Prolonged disruption or regulatory action can erode customer trust, increase remediation costs, and materially reduce revenue visibility over the medium term.
